title: lanq-makeready-fix undo record v1
description: One file per fix session, written by lanq-makeready-fix.ps1 (%LOCALAPPDATA%\lanq-makeready\fix-<UTC>.json) or lanq-makeready-fix.sh (${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/lanq-makeready/, or /var/lib/lanq-makeready/ as root). Each item is written as pending BEFORE its change and updated after it. The scripts write one item per line in this exact layout, pure ASCII, and reject on undo any file that does not have exactly these fields and shapes. Undo commands are derived from the fix id and the before state; no text from the file is ever run.

os.description: A record is undone only by the script for the same OS.

seq.description: Order the changes were made; undo goes from the highest down. Unique.

id.description: Windows: all six; Linux: ssh.start and power.sleep.

status.description: pending: written before the change (a crash leaves this); applied: changed and verified; failed: the change or its check failed (after holds what was found); undone: put back and verified. skipped is reserved (0.4.0 does not write it).

before.description: State before the change, in the fixed shape for the id (see stateShapes). Undo restores this.

command.description: The exact command(s) that were run, for people to read. Never executed.

after.description: State after the change, same shape as before, or 'unknown'. Undo acts only when the current state equals this ('changed since; left alone' otherwise).

stateShapes.description: Allowed before/after values per fix id. Anything else makes the whole record invalid.

windows:power.sleep.description: AC timeouts in seconds from powercfg /q; - = unreadable.

windows:ssh.aclkeys.description: DACL of administrators_authorized_keys in SDDL (allow/deny entries only).

linux:power.sleep.description: systemctl is-enabled of the four sleep targets (none = not found). Undo unmasks only the targets this fix masked.
